Hi Maria / Ian / Sarah —

Thanks again for making time. Attached is our first pass at the marketable product description and a support SLA matrix we intend to publish as part of listings for AWS, Azure, and GCP. The goal for this thread is to surface any platform-specific policy issues (branding, unsupported claims, or required wording) and confirm what evidence you need for the co-sell / verified listing badges.

Key asks:
- Please flag any copy lines that violate marketplace marketing rules (e.g., "enterprise-grade" where platform guidelines require substantiation).
- Can you confirm whether a 24/7 support claim requires an assigned support escalation contact or a documented on-call roster?
- What logo and trademark approvals are needed for the co-sell tile? We have a provisional logo and a partner badge request in the Drive folder (link below).

Attachments: marketplace-copy-v1.docx (draft public blurb), support-sla-table.xlsx (SLA windows + response targets), co-sell-readiness-checklist.pdf

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing QA: initial marketing copy + SLA defs

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the packet, it looks thorough. A couple of quick things from the AWS Marketplace policy perspective:

1) Claims: The phrase "enterprise-grade" is permitted only if you include measurable attributes or customer references under our marketing policy. Suggest reword to "designed for production workloads" unless you want to add a short footnote with metrics or an approved case study.

2) Support SLA: AWS requires that a published SLA that implies 24/7 support be backed by an internal escalation path and a named contact (or team email) that is monitored in that window. If you want to keep the 24/7 claim, please provide the escalation contact and a one-page on-call process (can be redacted for PII).

3) Logos / co-sell tiles: For the AWS co-sell tile, we need explicit written approval from your legal team for the trademark use. Also include the PNG at 600x400 and SVG. We can accept provisional assets for the listing preview, but final approval is required pre-publication.

I've linked the relevant policy pages here: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/policy-marketing and the co-sell onboarding checklist (internal): https://internal.aws/marketplace/cosell-checklist (note: internal link).

If you can send a revised copy and the two items above, I can route to the listings team and legal for a quick review. Happy to do a 30-min sync if that helps.

Best,
Maria
Program Manager, AWS Marketplace
maria.lopez@amazon.com
